div.div:
Bot stays silent — the human care advocate
replies from the dashboard console.
Exceptions:
• handover_end or home_menu returns control to the bot
• photo_secure_upload starts the secure-upload flow
• a received photo gets “✅ Picture received.”
• any other postback gets a nudge card

div.div:
1. handover_start / handover_end (any state)
2. home_menu → Welcome carousel
3. home_* tile → that flow's on_start()
4. sched_pto / sched_swap cross-flow jumps
5. active flow.on_postback(pd)
6. prefix fallback across all flows
7. last resort: Bedrock assistant

div.div:
convertible image (JPEG/PNG/GIF/HEIC)
→ processing ack now; S3-triggered
media_convert does the JPEG + Bedrock
classify, then calls back
handle_media() — everything else:
UPLOAD_FAILED → format hint + Secure Upload
non-image (PDF/audio/video) → received card

div.div:
1. active flow = verification → otp.verify(code)
2. active flow = benefits_qa / find_care → Bedrock
3. active flow = store → re-show catalog
4. keyword router: “human/agent” → LIVE mode;
refill · appointment · store · verify · find
5. default → Benefits Q&A assistant
